summary: Specifies Pragmatic General Multicast (PGM), a reliable multicast transport protocol. A receiver in the group either gets all the data, including repairs, or learns that some loss could not be recovered. It is an experimental specification.

eli5.summary: When one person talks to a huge crowd, someone may miss a sentence. This is a way for people to ask for just the missed part again, or at least know they missed it.
